title: Music bed (no vocals)
judge_notes: audio/music_bed.wav is the instrumental bed under the voice-over (a single take is judged with the same questions). It must have no vocals of any kind, for its whole length.

questions.text: Is audio/music_bed.wav present and not empty?
Does the music last the film's duration?
Was the chosen bed judged voice-free on every judge pass of its take?
Is the bed free of silent gaps longer than a second (fades at the ends are fine)?
Is the music free of any vocals for its whole length: no singing, humming, choir, chant or spoken words?
questions.evidence: Name the second of any voice.

questions.text: Does the mood match screenplay.json music.prompt and the story's tone?
Does it leave room for the voice (no busy lead melody in the voice's range)?
Does it lift and resolve with the film's beats (a lift at the turn, a resolve at the end card)?
questions.evidence: Name the seconds of the lift and the resolve.

questions.text: Does it end cleanly on a resolved ending or a fade, not cut mid-phrase?
Is it clean: no clipping, glitches or audibly repeating loops?
questions.evidence: Name the second of any fault.

questions.text: Is it free of recognisable copyrighted melodies?
Is the style right for the brief's audience and setting?
